summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes bundled obfuscated payload
details: @servicetitan/anvil-icon@0.5.6 declares scripts.preinstall = 'node setup.mjs'. setup.mjs is hex-obfuscated code that constructs a URL of the form https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/<arch>.zip, downloads the Bun runtime, extracts and chmods the bun binary in a temp directory, and invokes it via execFileSync to run a sibling file math_init.js. math_init.js is a 727KB single-line, obfuscator.io-style bundle (string-array rotator, hex-named identifiers) whose actual behavior is not statically recoverable. Executing a downloaded alternate runtime against a large obfuscated payload at install time bypasses Node-based scanning and yields arbitrary code execution on the installer's host. The package advertises MDI SVG icons, for which neither a separate runtime nor a 727KB executable JS bundle is required; the scope name mimics ServiceTitan's Anvil design system, consistent with a lookalike/impersonation lure. Installing the package triggers this preinstall automatically.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
